_readme: Starter catalogue of 5K-only routes for SG Haze Run.
Every route must be exactly 5.0 km (+/-0.1) and finish where it starts.
start.lat/lng are APPROXIMATE. Confirm them when drawing the route (gpx.studio / plotaroute).
provisionalRegion is a human guess only. The app should assign each route to the NEA region whose regionMetadata label_location is nearest to start.
path: fill with [lng, lat] pairs (GeoJSON order) once the route is drawn. Set status to 'verified' once someone has run it.
water / toilets / litAtNight: fill with true/false once verified.

routes.name: East Coast Park – Bedok Jetty
routes.howToRun: Run east along the park connector toward Bedok Jetty, turn at 2.5 km, return.
routes.notes: Flat, sea breeze, plenty of toilets and water points. Busy at weekends.

routes.name: Bedok Reservoir Loop+

start.name: Bedok Reservoir Park (Bedok North Rd entrance)

routes.howToRun: One full reservoir loop (~4.3 km) plus a short out-and-back extension to make 5.0 km.
routes.notes: Popular, well-lit, gentle undulation.

routes.name: Pasir Ris Park Coastal
routes.howToRun: Loop along the beach path and mangrove boardwalk edge.
routes.notes: Flat, shaded sections, toilets along the beach.

routes.name: Changi Beach Park
routes.howToRun: Head west along the beach path from Changi Village, turn at 2.5 km.
routes.notes: Quiet and flat, good for sunrise runs. Less MRT-friendly.

routes.name: Punggol Waterway Park
routes.howToRun: Follow the waterway path, turn at 2.5 km.
routes.notes: Flat, scenic, well-lit. Region decided automatically (often reported under North/East).

routes.name: Sengkang Riverside Park
routes.howToRun: Loop the riverside park and Sungei Punggol path.
routes.notes: Flat, includes the Fruit Tree boardwalk area.

routes.name: Marina Bay Loop
routes.howToRun: Merlion → Esplanade → Helix Bridge → Marina Bay Sands promenade → back via Bayfront, extend toward Gardens by the Bay to reach 5.0 km.
routes.notes: Iconic and well-lit. Crowded in the evening.

routes.name: Kallang Basin & Sports Hub
routes.howToRun: Loop around the Kallang Basin via the Sports Hub, Kallang Riverside Park and Tanjong Rhu.
routes.notes: Flat waterfront, good night lighting.

routes.name: Bishan–Ang Mo Kio Park
routes.howToRun: Loop the park along the naturalised Kallang River plus one extension to reach 5.0 km.
routes.notes: Flat, green, popular with families. Toilets and water in the park.

routes.name: Singapore Botanic Gardens
routes.howToRun: Run from Bukit Timah Gate to Tanglin Gate and back via the Eco-Lake loop, repeating sections to reach 5.0 km.
routes.notes: Shaded and rolling. Opens 5am.

routes.name: Gardens by the Bay East & Marina Barrage
routes.howToRun: Marina Barrage → Gardens by the Bay East waterfront → turn at 2.5 km.
routes.notes: Flat with skyline views, windy and exposed.

routes.name: Labrador Park & Berlayer Creek
routes.howToRun: Berlayer Creek boardwalk → Labrador Nature Reserve coastal path, extend toward Keppel Bay to reach 5.0 km.
routes.notes: Shaded, some gentle hills.

routes.name: Sentosa Boardwalk & Beaches
routes.howToRun: Cross the Sentosa Boardwalk, continue along Siloso/Palawan beach path, turn at 2.5 km.
routes.notes: Flat beach running. Can be touristy in the daytime.

routes.name: Jurong Lake Gardens Loop
routes.howToRun: Loop around Jurong Lake via Lakeside Garden and the Chinese/Japanese Gardens, adjusted to 5.0 km.
routes.notes: Flat, scenic, toilets and water in Lakeside Garden.

routes.name: West Coast Park
routes.howToRun: Coastal path through the park, turn at 2.5 km.
routes.notes: Flat, quieter than East Coast.

routes.name: Rail Corridor (Hillview)
routes.howToRun: Join the Rail Corridor and run south toward the old Bukit Timah Railway Station, turn at 2.5 km.
routes.notes: Shaded green corridor. Mostly compacted gravel. Not lit at night.

routes.name: Woodlands Waterfront Park
routes.howToRun: Waterfront promenade and jetty, then along the coastal PCN, turn at 2.5 km.
routes.notes: Flat, views of Johor. Note: closest region to transboundary haze.

routes.name: Admiralty Park & Woodlands PCN
routes.howToRun: Loop Admiralty Park and connect to the Woodlands PCN to reach 5.0 km.
routes.notes: Green with some boardwalks.

routes.name: Lower Seletar Reservoir Park
routes.howToRun: Reservoir-side path, turn at 2.5 km.
routes.notes: Flat and quiet, good sunset spot.

routes.name: Sembawang Park & PCN
routes.howToRun: Through Sembawang Park and along the Sembawang PCN, turn at 2.5 km.
routes.notes: Quiet coastal park with a beach.
